热固性塑料能重新塑形吗？
How hard this thermoset cup is!
这个热固性塑料杯子好硬呀！
thesaurus: A thesaurus is a book about words.
同义词词典是一本讲单词的书。
Where is the thesaurus in the library?
图书馆里的同义词词典放在哪儿呀？
Find a new word in the thesaurus!
在同义词词典里找一个新词吧！
thorax: A bee has a thorax and six legs.
蜜蜂有胸部，还有六条腿。
Where is the thorax on the ladybug?
瓢虫的胸部在什么地方呢？
Look at the thorax on this big beetle!
thoroughbred: The thoroughbred horse runs very fast.
Is that white horse a thoroughbred?
He watches the thoroughbreds run on the grass!
他看纯种马们在草地上奔跑！
thousand: There are a thousand leaves on the big tree.
Did you write a thousand words?
A thousand thanks to my helper!
threadbare: 他的旧外套已经磨得很薄了。
Why is your backpack so threadbare?
你的书包怎么破成这样呀？
The threadbare blanket keeps me warm!
这条旧毯子照样能给我保暖！
threat: The rain is a threat to the little tent.
雨水对小帐篷来说是个威胁。
Is the big cat a threat to the bird?
The fox is a threat to the small chickens!
狐狸对小鸡们来说很危险！
